title: Race condition in chat message persistence
reasoning: persistMessages processes the last 2 messages sequentially without idempotency or deduplication. If called multiple times concurrently (e.g., rapid user messages or React strict mode double-invocation), the same messages could be persisted multiple times. There's no message ID, timestamp check, or server-side deduplication. The API likely appends blindly, causing duplicate history entries.
reproduction: 1. Trigger multiple rapid chat messages. 2. If persistMessages is called for each message with overlapping windows, the same message could be sent twice. 3. Check /api/portal-chat-history for duplicate entries.
recommendation: 1. Add unique message IDs (UUID) and send with each persistence request. 2. Make server API idempotent (upsert by message ID). 3. Implement request coalescing/debouncing to batch rapid calls. 4. Consider using a single persistence call with all new messages rather than last-2 slicing.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests included. Race conditions require concurrent execution tests which are not present.
suggestedRegressionTest: Test: Call persistMessages twice concurrently with overlapping message arrays. Mock API to track calls. Verify each unique message is persisted exactly once.
minimumFixScope: src/src/pages/AnttipPortal.tsx persistMessages function and /api/portal-chat-history API endpoint to add idempotency.
